title: Expand the number in scientific notation
Divide by one million
text: One million is $${10}^6$$, so checking $$2.1\times{10}^{11}$$ passwords at $${10}^6$$ passwords per second gives $$\frac{2.1\times{10}^{11}}{{10}^6}=2.1\times{10}^5$$ seconds.

title: Convert seconds to hours
text: There are $$3600={60}^2$$ seconds per hour, so $$\frac{2.1\times{10}^5}{3600}=58$$ hours
